newsitem.title: USA: US CORPORATE BONDS - Junk bond new issues steal show.
newsitem.headline: US CORPORATE BONDS - Junk bond new issues steal show.

text.p: Activity in the U.S. corporate bond market was dominated by new junk bond issues on Monday, market sources said.
This week's swollen calendar for new junk deals got even larger on Monday with rumors that McLeodUSA Inc will sell $175 million in cash-pay bonds via Salomon Brothers in the next several days.
Fears that the deal would be price cheaply caused spreads on outstanding McLeod 10.5 percent zero coupon bonds to widen around 20 basis points on Monday morning, a trader said.
But spreads returned to opening levels in the afternoon.
